# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly nine or ten years old when introduced, turning into a teenager by the end of Volume 1  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c15 P23](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0023), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a very attractive girl with a radiant skin tone, large, vivid blue eyes, and a full, eye-catching figure. She wears her hair styled up when in town, though she is required to wear it down at home. She is prone to crying or becoming hysterical during stressful situations.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 c26 P7](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0007), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Opal is sunny, pleasant, and delights in the enjoyable aspects of life, though she is prone to sentimentality and hysterics under pressure. She is preoccupied with boys and romance, continually focusing on suitors and dating rather than practical matters. Despite her romantic focus, she lacks a strong imagination for storytelling and struggles with subjects like algebra.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P7](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0007), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_

- Sunny and pleasant  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- Curing warts with an enchanted stone  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To get a boyfriend once she turns fifteen  <sub>[v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005)</sub>
- To teach for two years before getting married  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Opal attended Brierley school, where she shared classes with Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. During her school years, she participated in various activities, including the Sunday-school picnic, the story club, and the Christmas performance where she portrayed 'Hope' in a tableau. She joined Miss Thorne's extra Regent's prep class and subsequently moved to Port Marlow to take the Entrance examinations. Although she panicked over errors during the tests, she passed and qualified for Second Class teacher training. Following Regent's, she planned to teach for two years before marrying.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c34 P22](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0022)_
